Examples.Title: Submit content
Examples.Description: Moderate one piece of content: text, an image, a video, audio or an object with several fields. The project checks it against the policies of its channel and returns the result. Act on `recommendation.action` (allow, review or reject). The content is stored in the project unless `doNotStore` is set, and items to review go to the review queue. The project can send the result to its webhook endpoints.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create an action
Examples.Description: Create an action that reviewers and rules can take. `type` sets what it does: a built-in type changes the item or author in Moderation API, and a custom type (`ITEM_CUSTOM`, `AUTHOR_CUSTOM`) only records the decision for the webhooks to deliver. Creating an action does not execute it.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Execute moderation action
Examples.Description: Execute one action of the project, by ID or key, on content items or authors. A built-in action changes them in Moderation API (for example rejects the items or blocks the authors). Every executed action is recorded, and the project sends it to the webhooks of the action and to its other webhook endpoints, where the customer platform can act on it. List the actions first to see what each one does.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create a new author
Examples.Description: Create a new author. Typically not needed as authors are created automatically when content is moderated.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Update author details
Examples.Description: Update the details of a specific author
Examples.Code:
### Update author details
# @name author-openUpdate
PUT {{host}}/authors/{{id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Project-Id: {{Project-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "manual_trust_level": 2,
  "metadata": {
    "identity_verified": true
  }
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid input data
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Authorization not provided
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Insufficient access
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not found
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: Too many requests. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal server error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Send feedback
Examples.Description: Sends a feature request, bug report or other feedback to the Moderation API team. The team reads every request and can reply by email. Limited to 5 requests per minute per organization.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Resolve queue items
Examples.Description: Mark up to 100 items of a queue as resolved in one request. Each item is resolved the same as with `POST /queue/{id}/items/{itemId}/resolve`, and each ID is an item `id` or your `contentId`. IDs that match no item in the project are skipped and returned in `notFoundIds`.
Examples.Code:
### Resolve queue items
# @name resolveQueueItems
POST {{host}}/queue/{{id}}/items/resolve
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Project-Id: {{Project-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "itemIds": [
    "clx8k2v0e000108l4a9bz3f7q",
    "clx8k2v0e000208l4h2mc6d1r"
  ]
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful response
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid input data
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Authorization not provided
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Create a webhook
Examples.Description: Create a webhook subscribed to one or more event types. Deliveries use the v2 envelope and are signed with the project signing secret (see the signing secret endpoint).
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using ModerationAPI;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Add words to wordlist
Examples.Description: Add words to an existing wordlist
Examples.Code:
### Add words to wordlist
# @name wordlist-addWords
POST {{host}}/wordlist/{{id}}/words
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Project-Id: {{Project-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

  "words": [
    "free money",
    "click here"

}
